quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025) results: revenue HK$12,409.6 million, up 68.0% from HK$7,388.8 million (restated), mainly from higher revenue in the server sector and the data centre sector of cable assembly driven by the AI boom; gross profit HK$1,468.8 million (+35.6%), gross profit margin 11.8% versus 14.7% (restated) because of the larger share of the lower-margin server business; operating profit HK$907.8 million (+44.4%); EBITDA HK$1,187.2 million (+64.3%); profit for the year HK$783.6 million (+69.0%), net profit margin 6.3%. The average copper price was USD9,945 per ton (+8.7%); selling prices adjust automatically with copper, a revenue impact of approximately HK$50.2 million (0.4% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue HK$12,409.6 million (+68.0%); profit HK$783.6 million (+69.0%); gross margin 11.8%

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue by market sector: cable assembly HK$3,429.9 million (+23.2%), of which data centre HK$1,813.3 million (+49.4%; AI drove the fibre cable assembly business in data centres 'due to the upgrading of servers', orders stayed at a high shipment level, profitability relatively improved and it remained the highest revenue sector in cable assembly), telecommunication HK$540.8 million (-4.6%; limited capacity was allocated to the better-margin data centre sector), medical equipment HK$853.9 million (+4.6%; part of overseas orders hit by US tariffs), industrial equipment HK$50.4 million (+72.6%) and automotive HK$171.5 million (+8.8%; Linkz Cables Mexico started production and, because of tariffs, more customers are willing to transfer orders to Mexico); digital cable HK$1,224.9 million (-13.6%), of which networking cable HK$963.0 million (-18.4%; overseas orders hit by tariffs) and specialty cable HK$261.9 million (+10.5%; AI-driven high-speed cables at a better margin); copper wire HK$354.5 million (one month of the DJC Group).

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Group acquired the DJC Group (Dejinchang Investment Limited and its subsidiaries) on 3 December 2025, bringing vertically integrated copper wire production in-house (copper wire used in precision electronic devices, electrical appliances, computers, communication equipment, automobiles, medical devices, aerospace equipment and solar products). The DJC Group has three self-owned production facilities in Huizhou and Nantong (PRC) and Thailand and three leased facilities in Nantong, Ji'an and Vietnam, has served customers across Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, and its major customers are mainly listed corporations and reputable manufacturers in precision intelligent manufacturing, consumer electronics and photovoltaics. It keeps supplying copper wire for the Group's cable products and to independent customers; the company says the acquisition diversifies its reliance on a single country for copper wire and lets it explore sales to the USA through the DJC Group's facilities.

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Time Interconnect Singapore (Time Singapore), a joint venture the Company set up with Luxshare Precision Industry in 2024 to pursue overseas acquisitions and 49% owned by the Group (associate), acquired Leoni Kable GmbH from Leoni AG in July 2025; Leoni Kable develops, manufactures and sells connection systems, especially cables transmitting power and signals and automotive cables, with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Germany, Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, Turkey, USA, Mexico and the PRC. The Group's FY2025 share of Time Singapore and Leoni Kable results was a net profit of HK$79.7 million (total share of associates HK$76.3 million versus a HK$0.7 million loss). The company plans to use Leoni Kable's global footprint to expand its data centre sector business to more global potential customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Share of Time Singapore / Leoni Kable results HK$79.7 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Continuing connected transactions with Luxshare Precision Industry (controlling shareholder): under the Luxshare Precision Master Supply Agreement (renewed 24 March 2025 for 1 April 2025 to 31 December 2027) the Group sells cable products, medical equipment cables, copper wire products and server products to the Luxshare group; on 12 November 2025 the annual caps were raised from HK$240,000,000 to HK$1,598,000,000 for 2026 and HK$1,758,000,000 for 2027 and the term extended to 2028 with a proposed cap of HK$1,934,000,000, because the existing caps would not meet the Luxshare Group's demand. The Group also buys server product raw materials and cable product raw materials from the Luxshare Group (caps HK$170,000,000 for the nine months to 31 December 2025 and HK$240,000,000 for each of 2026 and 2027), and the Luxshare Group provides subcontracting services for the production of the Group's server products (caps HK$33,000,000, HK$63,000,000 and HK$110,000,000). Caps are ceilings, not sales.

players.product: AI / data-centre server products (server segment manufacturing)

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Server sector FY2025: revenue HK$7,400.3 million, up 132.1% from HK$3,188.1 million and 59.6% of Group revenue, driven by AI demand in data centres; in 2024 a shortage of key components supply had affected revenue. Server segment result HK$198,781 thousand (2024: HK$16,935 thousand); the larger share of this lower-margin business lowered the Group's margins. The server business runs a go-to-market strategy and JDM/ODM model deeply customised to brand customers' requirements, with products mainly applied in data centres; citing China's digital-infrastructure investment, PRC manufacturers raising the share of the local supply chain, and Luxshare Precision Industry's know-how and customer relationships, the company says it is optimistic on demand and will continue to expand and consolidate the server business.
quarterly_data.figure: Server revenue HK$7,400.3 million (+132.1%), 59.6% of revenue
